Your first time in an outrigger canoe.

No experience needed. The captains walk you through technique, timing and safety before you head out.

First-time session
For people who have never paddled. An introduction to the sport, guided by a captain.
Sunrise paddle
An early start, calm water and the city waking up, seen from the bay.
Sunset paddle
Salvador's late afternoon, seen from inside the Bay of All Saints.
Sea tour
For visitors who want to see the city's waterfront and history from the water.

Questions.

Do I need experience to paddle?

No. The first-time session is designed for people who have never paddled, and the captains cover technique and safety before you head out.

How do I book?

Send your request through the form or straight on WhatsApp. The team confirms your booking along with the time, price and meeting point.

Do you accept Gympass and TotalPass?

Yes. Ask the team which plans and options are eligible for check-in.

What if the sea conditions are poor?

The team checks sea conditions before every outing and will get in touch to arrange a new date if needed.

What should I bring?

Swimwear, sunscreen, water, a cap or visor and a dry bag for your phone.

Can children join?

Let the team know the children's ages to find out which experiences suit them.

Do you run corporate events?

Yes. Use the private experience form to request a quote.
